0.3.0 Performance Note Update


There are some fixes currently in the works, as some problems were actually found with avatars/player system in this release running logic when not rendered/not in view. That is what is causing some players to have "lag", its not actually the server or GPU(for most). Rendering performance is really really good this time around actually. It's the CPU that we have a bug with right now. So Hotfix might be in the near future.

As for possible GPU performance -- check minimum requirements. Make sure you have 8 GB of VRAM. Seen some very good results with even 1660's running good FPS. Low end testing here has went well.


Best advice for anyone really on low end PC:

-start the game
-access settings and turn off Vsync, set graphics preset to Low
-make sure you arent running some crazy resolution for your card, Low End PCs should stick with 1440p/1080p
-play in Calido, stay in one spot basically, and slowly turn up Custom settings to your liking and FPS tolerance.
-After you have changed a few settings, go back to main menu and enter Calido again(some graphics settings changes do better with a restart of a level)
-ALSO IMPORTANT, the engine takes up to 10 seconds to apply graphics settings, so when you change something let it settle for a moment.
-also keep hardware lumen off, its heavy

Access the above with command !lowend in Discord.


In addition as a general rule -


Graphics Preset Updates - Ultra settings now push visuals further than ever and have been recalibrated for next generation setups that have recently come to market. 

You do have the option in Video settings to play around custom presets - Global Illumination is one of the greatest resource pulls and you may have some luck individually adjusting this setting in addition to the Hardware lumen option.

Do not be afraid to try a general preset lower than you had in the previous release; this does not make you less than.  (edited)

Effective 1 August 2025:

Rewards will only be distributed to nodes actively delegated to a pool.
Any undelegated nodes after this date will no longer earn rewards, and the unallocated rewards will be redistributed amongst the delegated nodes.
This shift supports our broader mission: a performant, scalable, and community powered network.
